issues.reason: "Banach", "Mackey" and "Arens" are eponymous modifiers inside kind-naming terms of art, not referents of this sentence — the instruction set's own breton_tapestry fuses a capitalized modifier into an ordinary compound kind with no Name fact, and minting (Name banach "Banach") would introduce persons the text never refers to.

The "nothing in Compound concepts applies to a proper noun" clause governs multi-word names of individuals (kestrel_river, halvard_of_sunne); here the referent is a kind of topology predicated with Inheritance, so the head genus (Inheritance banach_mackey_topology topology) is the required-not-optional compound genus, and it is true and well-typed.

"weak" is a gradable adjective predicable of the referent ("the topology is weak"), which the compound rule says must be exposed (senior_contractor → senior), and the noun modifiers banach / mackey / arens were correctly left unexposed — the proper-noun bar does not reach a compound kind term.

gaps_confirmed: a frequency adverb over a habitual whose subject is a definite kind-naming term rather than a bare-plural kind — the strength channel is specified for a distributing rule or a flat generic, so 0.1 on individual event atoms is an unspecified extension
the downtoner "relatively" on a frequency adverb has no carrier — the table gives bare "rarely" = 0.1, and Degree covers adjectives and quantity, not frequency adverbials
new_gaps: eponymous technical kind-terms ("Banach-Mackey topology", "Hilbert space"): the mechanical casing cue (a capitalized run is a name, an adjacent lowercase common noun is not part of it) collides with the compound-kind route when the capitalized word is a classifying modifier of a KIND, and nothing states which route wins — the name route would also force Member on a kind-denoting symbol
notes: All three issues rest on one reclassification — term of art vs proper name — and every atom the parse emits is true and well-typed under the compound-kind reading it chose. The hyphen-tokenization garble leaves the constituency of "weak" undecidable; per Multiple live readings that is parsed as best one can, not treated as ambiguity.
